summary: Implement Proxy [[GetPrototypeOf]] via getPrototypeOf trap with result and non-extensible-target invariants.

target.notes: Validate revocation, perform GetMethod trap lookup, call the trap with handler as this, then enforce the ECMAScript Proxy invariant before returning.

semantics.truthiness: not coerced; invalid primitive result throws TypeError
semantics.invariant: if target is non-extensible, trap result must be SameValue as target [[GetPrototypeOf]]

caveats: If the trap is absent/undefined, forward to the corresponding target internal method.
Trap property lookup itself can invoke a getter and throw.
A C# interceptor that trusts the trap result without target invariant checks is not semantics-preserving.

tests.name: non-extensible target mismatch throws
tests.input: const t={};Object.preventExtensions(t);const p=new Proxy(t,{getPrototypeOf(){return null}});try{Reflect.getPrototypeOf(p)}catch(e){console.log(e instanceof TypeError)}
